ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to 6 months following the Termination Date at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within 30 days after the Termination Date, return to the Company all Content, user information and customer data of the Company then in HDI's possession or control, in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete all such Content, user information and customer data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short exit provision at the end of Section 4 requiring HDI to provide up to 6 months of transition assistance at its then-current rates and to return our Content and customer data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, then delete and certify deletion. The agreement is silent on exit today, which would leave our site data stranded on termination; we can accept 90 days of assistance with export within 30 days as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 4.3 requiring up to 6 months' transition assistance at then-current rates and return of Company data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, followed by deletion and written certification.
